# Modern 3-Bedroom Apartment for Rent in Urban Residence, Bratislava – N

> We offer for rent a spacious and fully furnished 3-bedroom apartment in the popular Urban Residence development on Račianska Street, Bratislava – New Town (Nové Mesto). The apartment offers 72.64 m² of living space plus a spacious 10.37 m² balcony and is located on the 1st floor of a modern residential building completed in 2019. Apartment features 3 separate rooms Fully furnished 72.64 m² Spaciou
